item.description:
# Minimal Data Studio 0.2.2
- Manage running and recent projects from the Mac app, with New project, Open, Finder, and Stop controls. - See database size, table/view counts, and clickable local addresses. - Reuse one server per project and detect conflicting saves from other browser tabs. - Automatically check SQL, Python, and R when opening a project. Expand the status summary for results and troubleshooting. - Choose managed or custom Python and R installations per project in Advanced settings. - Fix a preview server failure when sending notebook input tables to Python or R. - Refine the project manager layout, action buttons, cursor feedback, and app icon loading.
Includes Python and R. Apple Silicon; macOS 14 or newer.
